title: Battle of Freiberg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Freiberg", at revision 1370441085, opens: "The Battle of Freiberg was fought on 29 October 1762 and was the last great battle of the Third Silesian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q677892, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle in 1762 in Germany". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
